pages.title: Below the Ice
pages.text: Wear a Salvager Helmet and obtain a Ship Graveyard Echo.

pages.title: Below the Ice
pages.text: Prepare for deep exploration and its equipment upkeep.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Acquire the helmet and echo through the local recipes and expedition loot. The task checks equipment and the echo, not a dive or a repair. Read the echo’s uses before spending it.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Use Silk Touch for icicles and Frost Walker or Feather Falling boots when crossing thin ice. Icicles can fall after vibrations/projectile impacts; light melts frost and ice decorations.
